STEP 1 - Scene: An airline-style breakfast tray on a white tray table, photographed from a frontal, slightly elevated angle. Items include two fried eggs with a muffin-style sandwich, toast, blueberries, yogurt, jam/spread portions, juice, and tea.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The main plate (left, with eggs and sandwich) is a disposable round plate about 20 cm in diameter (area ~314 cm²). The toast plate (center) is similar, ~20 cm (area ~314 cm²). The blueberry bowl is ~12 cm wide.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Fried eggs (2)
- Sausage/ham and cheese muffin sandwich
- Toast slices (4 slices)
- Blueberries
- Yogurt (cup, ~150 g container)
- Jam/fruit spread portions and butter portions
- Juice (apple-style, ~200 ml glass)
- Tea with milk (~200 ml mug)

STEP 4 - Area (main plate, 314 cm²):
- Eggs ~35% (110 cm²) x 1 cm = 110 ml x 0.9 = 99 g
- Sandwich ~20% (63 cm²) x 3 cm = 189 ml x 0.9 = 170 g (includes bread and filling)

STEP 5-6 - Toast plate (314 cm²):
- Toast 4 slices ~45% (141 cm²) x 2.5 cm stack = 353 ml; bread at 0.3 g/ml = 106 g. (Bread slices are light; using the stated bread density.)

Bowl and containers:
- Blueberries ~ 60 g (small bowl, ~80 ml, 0.7 g/ml = 56 g)
- Yogurt cup: 150 g
- Jam/butter portions: ~4 small cups, about 40 g total
- Juice: 200 g
- Tea with milk: 200 g (drink, low energy; ~ 0.5 kcal/100g with milk ~20 kcal total; counted at 30 kcal/100g for milk-tea)

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Eggs: 99 g x 155 kcal/100g = 153 kcal
- Muffin sandwich (bread + sausage/cheese): 170 g x 260 kcal/100g = 442 kcal
- Toast: 106 g x 265 kcal/100g = 281 kcal
- Blueberries: 56 g x 57 kcal/100g = 32 kcal
- Yogurt: 150 g x 100 kcal/100g = 150 kcal
- Jam/butter portions: 40 g x 250 kcal/100g = 100 kcal
- Juice: 200 g x 46 kcal/100g = 92 kcal
- Tea with milk: 200 g x 30 kcal/100g = 60 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ~1,300 g... more precisely, 99 + 170 + 106 + 56 + 150 + 40 + 200 + 200 = 1,021 g, about 1 kg, and ~1,310 kcal. This is a plausible full airline breakfast tray for one person, with the drinks being a large share of the weight.
